metadata.description: Every ui:build consumer here builds it as its first command, under the env fixture below, instead of through dependsOn: a dependency task inherits only the caller's environment, so it could not carry the fixture. The fixture is the non-secret local URLs ci.yml sets workflow-wide plus the self-host TAU_CLOUD_ENABLED, so a clean checkout builds with no untracked apps/ui/.env; the tier's own server sets its runtime origins. ui:build declares each of these as an env input, so the self-host and the cloud (desktop-e2e, test:e2e:live) variants never share a cache entry, and building immediately before the specs means the variant in apps/ui/build is always this target's own (desktop-e2e:test:e2e, which writes the cloud variant there, runs with parallelism false).

commands: vitest run --config apps/ui-e2e/vitest.config.ts --project chromium src/webgpu-qualification.spec.ts src/graphics-backend.spec.ts src/shader-fixture.spec.ts src/section-view-contour-fill.spec.ts src/section-view-control-restyle.spec.ts src/section-view-overlap-cap-shading.spec.ts src/section-view-overlap-performance-diagnostics.spec.ts src/user-project-thumbnail-generation.spec.ts src/headless-chat-image-capture.spec.ts src/headless-chat-image-capture.performance.spec.ts src/metal-morph-loader.spec.ts

metadata.description: global-setup starts `react-router dev` itself rather than through ui:dev, so this target carries ui:dev's copy-assets dependency: without it a clean checkout serves the SPA fallback for the vendored fonts and esbuild.wasm.

metadata.description: The degraded mode of T2.9: the snapshot production server without COOP/COEP, so kernels must fall back to their single-threaded builds, say why, and still export exact bytes. Its own PORT keeps it from reusing an isolated server another e2e target started.

metadata.description: Opt-in live provider tier: the two specs that spend real provider credit and then assert the billing receipts they produced. The UI is built by the first command rather than a dependsOn, because it must be the cloud variant (TAU_CLOUD_ENABLED=true is a build-time input of ui:build) and a dependency task inherits only the caller's environment — a self-host bundle's transport omits fundedOperations entirely, so no receipt could exist to assert. global-setup.ts starts the UI only: the tier needs a cloud API already listening at TAU_E2E_API_URL (default :4000) with TAU_CLOUD_ENABLED=true, the BILLING_* secrets and the placeholder STRIPE_* values apps/api/.env.example names — nothing on the funded path calls Stripe. Also needs `pnpm infra:up` and one `pnpm db:migrate` per database fork.
Qualify hover, selection, list labels and source edits on the serial browser path; the existing picovoxel-multi spec owns browser pthread and cross-origin-isolation qualification.
